people.name: Saskia
people.bio:
Saskia has spent over 15 years at the intersection of content, storytelling,
and brand building- long before “social media strategy” became an
industry.

Originally building her own global platform as an influencer and founder, she went on to launch multiple ventures, including an award-winning wellness brand and a bestselling cookbook published by Penguin Random House.

Since then, she has worked across fitness tech, wellness, lifestyle, and
personal brands—advising founders and companies on how to position,
grow, and scale with both cultural relevance and commercial impact.

Having operated on both sides of the industry, she brings a rare dual
perspective—understanding what brands need, and what audiences
actually respond to. This allows her to bridge the gap between strategy and
execution in a way that feels both intuitive and effective.

Saskia leads on strategy, positioning, and brand direction - ensuring
everything Glasshouse builds is not just visible, but meaningful.
people.note: Ask her about: the audit that starts every account.

people.name: Bella
people.bio:
Bella began in the fashion world, building her own brand and quickly turning content into serious commercial results - scaling to millions of views, with single posts driving tens of thousands in sales.

What set her apart was a rare instinct: understanding not just what looks
good, but what moves - what people stop for, engage with, and buy into.
She has a natural ability to translate a brand into content that feels culturally relevant and impossible to ignore.

What started as creating for her own brand evolved into leading campaigns
for others-and ultimately, founding Glasshouse.

Bella leads on creative execution, editing, and viral language; shaping
content that doesn’t just perform, but defines the moment
people.note: Ask her about: the first three seconds.
